## Evidence

Select the strongest evidence actually available:

- [ ] PROVEN BY SOURCE
- [ ] PROVEN BY TEST
- [ ] PROVEN BY RUNTIME

Do not mark runtime evidence unless the behavior was observed in a real runtime.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests pass
- [ ] Failure path considered/tested where applicable
- [ ] Documentation updated where behavior/configuration changed
- [ ] UI changes include current screenshots where applicable
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, customer data, private keys or signing material added
- [ ] Third-party content/assets/feeds introduced by this change have an explicit compatible-use basis

State anything not yet verified.
